<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindAJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ConfirmationAndApplicationRating" name="Application receipt confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyReview" name="Company review"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Applicant rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationOutcome" name="Probation outcome"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Receipt confirmation and application rating" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAndRateApplication" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Job offer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyReview" name="Company review" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Event_CompanyReviewReceived" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Applicant rating" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Event_ApplicantRatingReceived" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationOutcome" name="Probation outcome" sourceRef="Task_SendProbationOutcome" targetRef="Event_ProbationOutcomeReceived" messageRef="Message_ProbationOutcome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationMerge" name="Continue job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Write and send job application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ConfirmationReceived" name="Receive confirmation and application rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ConfirmationReceived" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndApplicationRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview if applicable"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferWaitMerge" name="Wait for job offer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Receive job offer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplicantProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicantRatingSplit" name="Complete post-probation actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company and submit review"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyReviewReceived" name="Receive company rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyReviewReceived" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProbationOutcomeReceived" name="Receive probation outcome">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProbationOutcomeReceived" messageRef="Message_ProbationOutcome"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicantRatingJoin" name="Post-probation actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold" name="Rated company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PermanentJob" name="Permanent job"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContinueOffersNoReport" name="Continue receiving job offers without reporting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JobNotPermanent" name="Job did not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Applicant" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationMerge" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Event_ConfirmationReceived" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_OfferWaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferWaitMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Task_ApplicantProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_ApplicantProbation" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingSplit" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingSplit" targetRef="Event_CompanyReviewReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Event_CompanyReviewReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingSplit" targetRef="Event_ProbationOutcomeReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Event_ProbationOutcomeReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantRatingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" name="Permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">permanent = true()</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" name="Not permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="EndEvent_JobNotPermanent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">permanent = false()</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A19" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold" targetRef="Task_ContinueOffersNoReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">companyRating <= 'C'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A20" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_PermanentJob">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">companyRating > 'C'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A21" sourceRef="Task_ContinueOffersNoReport" targetRef="Gateway_OfferWaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A22" sourceRef="EndEvent_ContinueOffers" targetRef="EndEvent_ContinueOffers"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company job application and probation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmAndRateApplication" name="Confirm receipt and rate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyNegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview if applicable"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send job offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyProbation" name="Conduct probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" name="Complete post-probation actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant and send rating"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ApplicantRatingReceived" name="Receive applicant review">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicantRatingReceived" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year after review">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PermanentDecision" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProbationOutcome" name="Send probation outcome"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationJoin" name="Post-probation actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyComplete" name="Post-probation process complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoOffer" name="No job offer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmAndRateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAndRateApplication" targetRef="Task_CompanyNegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_CompanyNegotiateInterview" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_CompanyProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_CompanyProbation" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" targetRef="Event_ApplicantRatingReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Event_ApplicantRatingReceived" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" name="Permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision" targetRef="Task_SendProbationOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">permanent = true()</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" name="Not permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision" targetRef="Task_SendProbationOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">permanent = false()</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Task_SendProbationOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
